name: Admin: describe schema
description: Discovers the CKR Dataverse tables and columns that admin_query_records can filter, select, or sort by, resolved live from Dataverse's own EntityDefinitions/Attributes metadata rather than a hard-coded list, so it can't drift from what actually exists in this environment. Also resolves the human-readable labels for Choice/Picklist columns (e.g. ckr_topicstatus) where the environment supports it. Each column includes writable from IsValidForUpdate. Lookup columns also include writeField, the attribute logical name to send to admin_bulk_writeback (field stays the read form, _logicalname_value). Call with a table to get its columns, or omit table to list every ckr_ entity. Call this before admin_query_records or admin_bulk_writeback if you don't already know the field names for a table.

inputFields.label: Table
inputFields.description: Optional. The CKR entity to describe, by its Dataverse logical name or entity set name (e.g. ckr_interview / ckr_interviews). Omit to list every entity whose logical name starts with ckr_.
